name: custom-api-models
description: OpenAI Chat Completions only; explicit routes; account defaults with explicit session overrides; per-route effort for WorkBuddy / CodeBuddy Code.

ENABLED.title: Model source
ENABLED.description: Legacy fixed-host source override: third-party or official. The public tools default to account scope; models_switch with scope=session is an explicit local override.

PRESET.title: Preset
PRESET.description: Advanced compatibility preset for an old explicit config. Leave empty for the public explicit-route flow.

BASE_URL.title: Base URL
BASE_URL.description: OpenAI Chat Completions-compatible base URL (https). No protocol translation is provided.

API_KEY.title: API key
API_KEY.description: Legacy local credential for a fixed host. Account apply resolves private references into the authorized private account package.

ROUTES.title: Routes (JSON)
ROUTES.description: Legacy fixed-host explicit route JSON, e.g. {"official-slot":{"provider":"example","model":"upstream-model-id"}}
